mapping.draft_py:
# M20 Masterful Replication (copy round B3, DESIGN_ATOM_ONTOLOGY §18)
_bf = Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.ANY)
_artifact_you = FAnd(children=(
    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Artifact'),
    FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
))
golems = A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {
    'count': QConst(value=2),
    'tokens': TokenSpec(
        name='Golem', type_line='Artifact Creature — Golem', types=('Artifact', 'Creature'),
        subtypes=('Golem',), power=QConst(value=3), toughness=QConst(value=3), keywords=(),
        abilities=(),
    ),
})
# "Choose target artifact you control. Each other artifact you control becomes a copy of that
# artifact until end of turn.": the target is the copy's source (the one designation, T1), the
# other artifacts you control the permanents that become copies, until end of turn.
become = A(Verb.COPY, {
    'duration': DurationEot(),
    'source': CopyOf(source=Selector(count=QConst(value=1), mode=SelectorMode.TARGET,
                                     filter=_artifact_you, zones=(_bf,))),
    'cards': Selector(
        count=QUnbounded(),
        mode=SelectorMode.ALL,
        filter=FAnd(children=(_artifact_you, FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_ANY_TARGET)))),
        zones=(_bf,),
    ),
})
abilities = [SpellAbility(kind=SpellKind.INSTANT, effect=Choose(count=QConst(value=1), options=(golems, become)))]

clauses.clause: • Create two 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature tokens.
Each other artifact you control becomes a copy of that artifact until end of turn.

Cost {5}{U} paid once (mana C-5 U-1).

clauses.clause: Create two 3/3 colorless Golem artifact creature tokens.
clauses.evidence: Probe '[cast modes=[0]]': 'you:Golem#1 moves new -> battlefield (by card/CREATE_TOKEN)' and Golem#2, 'change: + you:Golem#1 (battlefield, you, 3/3)', '+ you:Golem#2 (... 3/3)': two tokens, 3/3, under your control, no target asked. Tree: TokenSpec name Golem, type_line 'Artifact Creature — Golem', types (Artifact, Creature), no colours (colourless), no abilities. The trace cannot show colour or the artifact type: colourless is read from the tree (no colours), and pack A01_9 shows the tokens ARE artifacts (a second copy-mode cast changes both). Pack A01_8: mode one changes nothing else.

Probe: '- target slot (cast modes=[1]): 1..1 of [you_relic]': one target; the standard board holds your artifact (you_relic), the opponent's (opp_relic), your creatures and your enchantment, and only your artifact is offered (not the opponent's artifact, not a non-artifact). Pack A01_7 pins the slot on a richer board: my three artifacts only, not my non-artifact creature, not the opponent's artifact creature.

clauses.clause: Each other artifact you control becomes a copy of that artifact until end of turn.
clauses.evidence: The standard board has one artifact of yours, the target itself, so '[cast modes=[1] targets=[you_relic]]' changes nothing. Tree: COPY(source=CopyOf(target artifact you control), cards=ALL artifacts you control that are not the target, duration EOT). Packs (all pass on the live tree and against the packet's tree): A01_1 (copiable values taken: name/type/P/T of the target; Beta's own counter kept, so a 1/1 with a counter is 5/5; non-artifacts, the opponent's artifact and the target unchanged; a noncreature artifact becomes a creature), A01_2 + A01_11 (ends at end of turn: P/T, name and type come back; a token stays a token), A01_3 (not copied: an Aura on the original, a pump on the original, damage, tapped status), A01_4 (the copy does not enter: no copied enters trigger, CR 707.4), A01_5 + A01_6 (abilities copied, usable while the original is tapped, gone at end of turn), A01_10 (copy of a nontoken by a token), A01_12 (the set is fixed as the spell resolves, CR 611.2c: an artifact entering later is unchanged), A01_13 (an Equipment that becomes a creature copy becomes unattached, CR 704.5p), A01_14 (the original's 'as it enters' colour choice is not copied, CR 707.6), A01_15 (copy of a noncreature artifact: no longer a creature, never asked to attack), A01_16 (a legendary target: the copy has the same name, so the legend rule applies and one is put into the graveyard, CR 704.5j). A01_17 (a copy of a copy copies the copy, CR 707.3: the second cast's target is already a copy), A01_18 (the target is gone on resolution: the spell does nothing, CR 608.2b). CR 707.2, 707.3, 613.2a. Open fault met (named, not judged): an Aura whose host stops matching its 'enchant' restriction stays attached (see the report; repro: a creature enchanted by 'Enchant creature' Oakenform, target a noncreature artifact: the Aura should go to the graveyard, CR 704.5m).
